page.layout: One printed page on the scan. The left page is blank apart from show-through and a library stamp. The right printed page is cut off at the scan edge, so only a narrow strip of its lines is visible: a title-like page with large capitals and short lines at the top and in the middle.
page.notes: The right printed page is cropped at the scan edge; only word fragments are visible, so the lines are transcribed as far as they can be read. The left page is blank. The faint marks across the middle of the left page are show-through from the reverse and are not transcribed. The round brown stamp (HERZOG AUGUST BIBLIOTHEK WOLFENBÜTTEL) is a library stamp and is left out. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible.
